name: Oberon
source:
[i]"This is why you're still a child. You don't understand a woman's heart. All you care about is what's on the outside. You'll never be popular like that."[/i]

He's a moody, self-centered non-human. He loves Tia, but after having his wings taken, his great love turned to great hate.

He doesn't care about anyone else but Tia.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/mistonia/characters/oberon/]Aksys Games[/url]]
